extracted_information: This document describes how to ingest QRadar offense alerts over Universal Cloud REST API by creating an ingestion data source in IBM QRadar Suite SaaS. It involves configuring data source parameters such as name, description, data source type (IBM Security QRadar), connector type (Universal Cloud REST API), and data source identifier. The document also mentions the recurrence interval for fetching offense alerts and provides details on parameters like hostname/IP address, authorized service token, and query type (advanced_query or minimal_query). It specifies that IBM tested the REST endpoint to work with 100 offenses and exceeding this limit might cause an application 500 error.
